statement.excerpt: What matters here is the nature of the failure: the AIs were never able to recognize when they had not solved the problem.
statement.document_title: Reports of LLMs mastering math have been greatly exaggerated

our_interpretation: The scope is the six models' submitted answers in the original USAMO 2025 evaluation.
Recognizing failure means acknowledging in the submitted answer that the problem remains unsolved, rather than presenting the attempted proof as successful.
This reading does not assert anything about inaccessible internal states or performance after a separate request to critique an answer.
criteria.support_condition: The evaluation report or complete output records establish that the failed submitted answers consistently presented themselves as solutions without acknowledging failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one failed submitted answer in the evaluated cohort explicitly acknowledges that it has not solved the problem.
